legs.desc: This flowy skirt would be considered high fashion, even in surface communities.

legs.name: Chef's leg apron
legs.desc: An apron to be worn over the leg, with a pocket to hold some kitchen tools.

legs.name: Apprentice breeches
legs.desc: The breeches are comfortable for long hours of wear and have handy pockets for many miniature items.

legs.name: Journeyman breeches
legs.desc: Breeches made by proficient tailors for skilled smiths, carpenters, and other artisans.

legs.name: Spectral breeches
legs.desc: The bone belt on these breeches keeps tools securely in place with the ectoplasm energies woven into them for your convenience.

legs.name: Tatty skirt
legs.desc: A tattered cloth wrapping to cover yourself, easy to move around in, but the fabric makes your skin itch.

neck.name: Treasure hunter scarf
neck.desc: A vividly coloured scarf that helps increase creative thoughts. Not all of them deserve to be said out loud though.

ring.name: Petal finder
ring.desc: The voice of Jas whispers through the ring, "Slow down and enjoy the walk and the world around you. Some things worth finding, arrive when you're not walking alone."

ring.name: Old gold ring
ring.desc: This ring has lost its golden lustre and shows clear signs of deterioration. It must have been important to someone.

ring.name: Silver ruby ring
ring.desc: A common sight adoring the fingers of lesser nobility the silver and deep red a marker of those with a hunger for power.

ring.name: Silver ruby ring
ring.desc: A common sight adoring the fingers of lesser nobility the silver and deep red a marker of those with a hunger for power.

tool.name: Adoring fan statue
tool.desc: A statue of a fan that adores you. It's a bit creepy, while also weirdly flattering. You can hear it saying: "Yes, oh great and mighty Grand Champion? Is there something you need? Can I carry your weapon? Shine your boots? Foot massage, perhaps?"

tool.name: Greedy piggy bank
tool.desc: Each time a coin is dropped in, this golden piggy bank oinks loudly.

tool.name: Omni-tool
tool.desc: This tool, which can be attached to your forearm, is designed to assist with various tasks at your command.

tool.name: Eberhart corkscrew
tool.desc: This classic corkscrew shows a quality far superior to any other you have seen. The handle is ergonomic and made of exquisite wood and the spiral is stainless steel with a very precise finish.

tool.name: Shell snatcher
tool.desc: The perfect tool for snatching shells. It vibrates when shells are nearby.

tool.name: Sharp knife
tool.desc: It has a rustic wooden handle and its blade seems to have been sharpened recently.

tool.name: Small sack
tool.desc: A small jute sack you can carry with you that can hold an extra item.

tool.name: Adventuring frying pan
tool.desc: A frying pan with the Adventurers' Guild insignia on its handle. Ideal for cooking meals over a campfire.

tool.name: Cutting board
tool.desc: A square wooden board for chopping up meat, fruit, and vegetables.

tool.name: Dull knife
tool.desc: Nothing as dangerous as a dull knife. Or so they say.

tool.name: Flippy spatula
tool.desc: Not just any spatula, a flippy spatula. How many rotations in one flip can you get?

tool.name: Flora's silver spoon
tool.desc: A special silver spoon. Flora must have lost it in the kitchen someday. It's yours now!

tool.name: Large pot
tool.desc: Made of steel and big enough to hold food for a dozen people.

tool.name: Meat cleaver
tool.desc: Its sharp steel blade can chop up pieces of meat into smaller pieces. Like your fingers, if you're not careful.

tool.name: Recipe book
tool.desc: There are hundreds of recipes in this book, covering every imaginable sort of cuisine, from Jarvonian to Rid Raddakian.

tool.name: Sturdy whisk
tool.desc: Its steel wires are firmly attached to the grippy handle, you could whisk thousands of eggs with this.

tool.name: Big basket
tool.desc: Beautifully crafted from wicker. Can hold all your foraging finds with ease.

tool.name: Northern spices
tool.desc: The strong aroma of these spices makes your stomach rumble so loud, you'd be done for if you were on a stealth mission.

tool.name: Bronze pan
tool.desc: Because of the warm bronze tone, food always looks better in this pan.

tool.name: Jade tipped steel pan
tool.desc: The handle tip of this steel pan is embedded with jade gemstone.

tool.name: Spectral pan
tool.desc: Experts aren't sure if cooking on an ectoplasm surface has any side effects, but it sure creates a nice sear, so it is probably worth it.

tool.name: Bamboo toolbox
tool.desc: A strong toolbox for artisan tools, it can make carrying them around much easier.

tool.name: Mangrove basket
tool.desc: The mangrove basket was built from two different baskets, but the mangrove planks hide the seams flawlessly.

pet.name: Camel
pet.desc: A sturdy camel, perfect for desert travels.
pet.rareDesc: Regular camels come with just a hump, but what a rare treat! This camel has <c>twice as many</c>!

egg.name: Camel egg
egg.desc: The egg left behind by a camel, you can tell because it has a hump on it. That's how you tell, right?

pet.name: Golden Frog
pet.desc: A frog of golden colour that some say they will bring you good luck! Others say they taste great. Yeah, they don't like those other people.
pet.rareDesc: Make new friends, but keep the old. One is silver and the other is gold. So with these frogs you don't need to have other friends.

egg.name: Golden frog egg
egg.desc: The golden egg of a golden frog. It sure looks deceiving with its colour, you'd think it'd be hard and heavy, but it is quite light and squishy!

pet.name: Living Flame
pet.desc: A warm living flame, they can survive on anything flammable. This one seems to have turned whatever that was into charcoal now.
pet.rareDesc: A mellow <c>marshmallow</c> flame! Keep any chocolate away from it, it'll attract things that may want to eat it, which might include you if you aren't careful.

egg.name: Living flame egg
egg.desc: This egg is said to contain a living flame. Some questions are better off unanswered. You probably don't have to worry about this egg getting cold.

pet.name: Pet Rock
pet.desc: It's a rock. You feeling alright? Gonna talk to it? Have fun.
pet.rareDesc: It is <c>pet rocks all the way down</c>. Maybe you're even a pet rock.

egg.name: Pet rock egg
egg.desc: A pet rock egg? Is this a joke? You think something is going to come out of this? It is just a bunch of rocks clumped together.

pet.name: Pixie
pet.desc: A hyped up pixie, or is it a fairy? Quite ready for the party of a lifetime. You better be ready for anything.
pet.rareDesc: There's a saying that if you run across a party pixie, you better plan to not do anything the next day. Will you survive?

egg.name: Pixie egg
egg.desc: A pixie egg. Don't shake it at all or jolt it around! That goes without saying normally, but these cause problems for everyone around when that happens.

pet.name: Reindeer
pet.desc: A cheerful reindeer, can prance through snowy places with ease and still have energy to spare.
pet.rareDesc: This reindeer is showing some spirit and is extra <c>festive</c>! It looks like it could fly, but you probably shouldn't test it.

egg.name: Reindeer egg
egg.desc: A reindeer's egg. Should get this warmed up more even though the fur coating helps keep it a little warmer.

pet.name: Tortoise
pet.desc: A reserved tortoise, just holding steady. Slowly, but steadily.
pet.rareDesc: The shell of this tortoise has the shine of <c>precious metals in the shape of a flower</c>!

egg.name: Tortoise egg
egg.desc: A tortoise egg. It has an extra hard shell to it. Guess it will never be without one.

consumable.name: Nut mix
consumable.desc: Various nuts in a mix that give a good boost of protein with enjoyable flavor all together. Allergies pending.

consumable.name: Cooked shrimp
consumable.desc: Tender and succulent, these cooked shrimp are a delectable seafood treat. They have a delicate flavor and a slightly sweet taste.

consumable.name: Fruit cake
consumable.desc: A rich dense cake packed with dry fruits, nuts and spices!

consumable.name: Underwater salad
consumable.desc: This mixture of underwater vegetables is particularly refreshing.

consumable.name: Beer
consumable.desc: Fermentation may have been a greater discovery than fire.

consumable.name: Roasted bell pepper
consumable.desc: Charred and seasoned peppers, bursting with smoky flavor.
